name: Audit an Elementor addon for stored XSS
query: A security report says our Elementor addon has stored XSS via widget settings. Find and fix it.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Review render() and content_template() of every widget for unescaped settings and raw {{{ }}} output
Step 3: Validate HTML tag settings against an allow list
Step 4: Replace manual link printing with add_link_attributes()
Step 5: Test with XSS payloads in text, URL and select controls
success_criteria: Payloads render inert on the frontend and in the editor preview
Fix covers all widgets, not only the reported one
